issues: Homepage is blank after the product grid: categories, story, stats, gallery, quote, CTA and footer are stuck at opacity 0 because the IntersectionObserver reveal hides content until it fires. This hits all three homepage renders.

Invalid calc() (`84px +clamp(...)`, missing whitespace) drops the hero padding, so on mobile the hero title sits under the sticky header and on the catalog page the breadcrumb and title collide with the nav.
Mobile scrolls horizontally: the starburst on the story bezel (right:-18px) and the oversized orbit/hero card push past the 390px viewport.
The hero card's holo overlay at 0.75 opacity washes the hero photo out into a flat lilac smear, so the main image is barely readable for both brands.
Product photos use object-fit:cover on white packshots, which crops the kart and the gloves. The cards read like a generic shop grid, not collectibles.
The signature shimmer only changes the card face. The chrome border stays static, so the interaction feels thin for a 'collectible' concept.
Typography and chrome headline treatment are strong and survive the stress brand. The starbursts and tapes are on-brief.
Big empty gaps between sections make the rhythm sag, partly because of the hidden reveal blocks.
fixed: Replaced the JS reveal with CSS scroll-driven animations (animation-timeline:view()) behind @supports. Content can't get stuck invisible: browsers without support, full-page captures and reduced-motion users all see everything. Staggered ranges keep the card cascade.
Fixed calc() spacing in the hero and catalog hero so content clears the floating header on every viewport.
Clipped horizontal overflow on html/main and pulled the starbursts and hero card in on mobile.
Toned down the hero card hologram overlay (0.4, multiply layer 0.3) so the photo stays clear and the foil still reads.
Product cards are now collectibles: uncropped object-fit:contain packshots on a pearl spotlight with a brand-tinted rim and drop shadow, plus a 'Nº 01' serial stamp via CSS counters.
Extended the signature interaction: on pointer move the chrome border becomes a holographic conic foil that rotates and recentres with the same CSS variables (--px/--mx/--my) the JS already drives.
